format_rule: One narration line = one shot. Narrator (SUTRADHAR, the wolf) shots come from prompts/library.json narrator_shots; story shots show people.

shorts.title: शिवलिंग में समा गई रानी
shorts.twist: राजा को शक था, पर रानी आधी रात शिव पूजा करने जाती थी
shorts.teaser: none (outro asks viewers to follow and name the next city)
shorts.note: Approved story (owner Gate 1, 2026-11-28) rebuilt in 2D noir + wolf narrator + तुम-form. Legend throughout: 'कहते हैं' / 'लोक-कथा'. Respect: Shivling always whole; king's sword always sheathed.

shots.vo: कहते हैं, अकोला की एक रानी शिवलिंग में समा गई थी।
shots.tts: [mysterious] कहते हैं, अकोला की एक रानी... [whispers] शिवलिंग में समा गई थी।
shots.prompt: high above a dark moonlit courtyard at midnight, a small old stone Shiva shrine with carved sandstone pillars and a dark polished stone Shivling on its base in the centre, brass oil lamps glowing, its low doorway glowing warm gold in a dark moonlit courtyard, {AKOLA_RANI} seen from behind standing at the threshold
shots.motion: Slow push-in toward the glowing doorway. The lamp light swells softly around the queen's silhouette. End with the doorway glow filling the upper frame.
shots.goal: Open on the mystery: a queen at a glowing shrine at midnight.
shots.sfx: night crickets, a soft rising temple-bell shimmer

shots.vo: @intro1
shots.tts: @intro1

vars.extra: toward a reading table where an old palm-leaf folk-tale book lies open

shots.goal: Introduce the narrator walking in to greet the viewer.
shots.sfx: his footsteps on stone, quiet archive room tone

shots.vo: @intro2
shots.tts: @intro2

vars.topic_visual: a tiny old stone Shiva shrine glowing at midnight beside a sleeping town of Akola

shots.goal: The narrator presents today's city and story from his scroll.
shots.sfx: parchment unrolling, a faint shimmer as the shrine rises

shots.vo: लोक-कथा कहती है, यहाँ अकोलसिंह नाम का एक राजा था।
shots.tts: [thoughtful] लोक-कथा कहती है... यहाँ अकोलसिंह नाम का एक राजा था।
shots.prompt: {AKOLA_RAJA} standing on the mud rampart of a small walled medieval town at dusk, looking out over flat cotton fields and a river
shots.motion: Very slow push-in on the king. His turban's pearl string catches the last light. End on his face in profile.
shots.goal: Introduce the legendary king Akolsingh.
shots.sfx: evening wind over fields, distant cattle bells

shots.vo: उसी के नाम पर इस जगह का नाम पड़ा, अकोला।
shots.tts: उसी के नाम पर इस जगह का नाम पड़ा... अकोला।
shots.prompt: a small medieval town ringed by an earthen mud wall beside a river, little houses and a few lamp-lit windows, flat fields all around, dusk
shots.motion: Slow high drift over the town. Lamps flicker on in a few windows. End with the whole walled town in frame.
shots.goal: Show the town said to carry his name.
shots.sfx: soft wind, faint town murmur

shots.vo: उसकी रानी हर आधी रात कहीं चली जाती थी।
shots.tts: [whispers] उसकी रानी हर आधी रात... कहीं चली जाती थी।
shots.prompt: {AKOLA_RANI} walking alone down a sleeping moonlit lane of the old town, holding a small brass oil lamp, her veil over her head, long shadows on the walls
shots.motion: Slow tracking shot beside her as she walks past dark doorways. The lamp flame sways. End with her turning a corner into the dark.
shots.goal: Show the queen's secret midnight walk.
shots.sfx: soft barefoot steps, anklets tinkling faintly, a dog far away

shots.vo: राजा को शक हुआ।
shots.tts: [serious] राजा को शक हुआ।
shots.prompt: {AKOLA_RAJA} watching from a dark palace window, half his face in shadow, moonlight on his eyes
shots.motion: Very slow push-in on his narrowed eyes. End on the eyes.
shots.goal: Show the king's suspicion.
shots.sfx: a single low drone, night silence

shots.vo: एक रात, वो तलवार लेकर, उसके पीछे-पीछे निकल पड़ा।
shots.tts: [tense] एक रात, वो तलवार लेकर... उसके पीछे-पीछे निकल पड़ा।
shots.prompt: over the shoulder of {AKOLA_RAJA} in the shadow of a wall, his sword sheathed at his hip, watching {AKOLA_RANI} far ahead carrying her lamp toward a small glowing shrine
shots.motion: Slow creep forward behind the king; he steps out of the shadow, hand resting on the sheathed sword hilt. End with the queen entering the shrine ahead.
shots.goal: Show the king secretly following the queen.
shots.sfx: careful footsteps, cloth rustle, night crickets

shots.vo: लेकिन ट्विस्ट तो यहाँ है।
shots.tts: [intrigued] लेकिन... ट्विस्ट तो यहाँ है।
shots.goal: The narrator cuts in to flag the turn.
shots.sfx: a quick whoosh, a paper rustle

shots.vo: रानी किसी से मिलने नहीं जा रही थी।
shots.tts: रानी किसी से मिलने नहीं जा रही थी।
shots.prompt: inside a small old stone Shiva shrine with carved sandstone pillars and a dark polished stone Shivling on its base in the centre, brass oil lamps glowing, the empty shrine with only the Shivling, fresh flowers and lamps, no one waiting there, calm and reverent
shots.motion: Slow pan across the quiet shrine from the doorway to the Shivling. End on the Shivling, whole and calm.
shots.goal: Reveal that no one was waiting for the queen.
shots.sfx: lamp flames flickering, deep quiet

shots.vo: वो राजेश्वर शिव मंदिर में पूजा करने जाती थी।
shots.tts: वो राजेश्वर शिव मंदिर में... पूजा करने जाती थी।
shots.prompt: inside a small old stone Shiva shrine with carved sandstone pillars and a dark polished stone Shivling on its base in the centre, brass oil lamps glowing, {AKOLA_RANI} kneeling before the Shivling, placing flowers and her brass lamp on the floor in front of it, devotional and calm
shots.motion: Gentle slow dolly in from the doorway. She sets the lamp down and bows her head. End with her kneeling, lamp glow on her face.
shots.goal: Show the true purpose: she came to worship.
shots.sfx: a soft temple bell, lamp flame

shots.vo: सोचो, उस पल राजा को कैसा लगा होगा?
shots.tts: [curious] सोचो... उस पल राजा को कैसा लगा होगा?

vars.context_visual: the small glowing shrine in his open book

shots.goal: Pull the viewer in with a question.
shots.sfx: a soft page turn, archive room tone

shots.vo: रानी ने भगवान शिव से प्रार्थना की।
shots.tts: [softly] रानी ने भगवान शिव से प्रार्थना की।
shots.prompt: inside a small old stone Shiva shrine with carved sandstone pillars and a dark polished stone Shivling on its base in the centre, brass oil lamps glowing, {AKOLA_RANI} with folded hands and closed eyes before the Shivling, lamp light on her face, the king's shadow just visible at the doorway behind her
shots.motion: Very slow push-in on her folded hands and face. End on her closed eyes.
shots.goal: Show the queen's prayer, with the king now watching.
shots.sfx: lamp flame, a faint breath

shots.vo: “अगर मैं निर्दोष हूँ, तो मुझे अपने में समा लो।”
shots.tts: [pleading] अगर मैं निर्दोष हूँ... [whispers] तो मुझे अपने में समा लो।
shots.prompt: close-up of {AKOLA_RANI}'s calm face with closed eyes, a single tear, lamp light flickering across her veil
shots.motion: Locked camera, the lamp light flickers across her face. End on her still, calm face.
shots.goal: Give the queen's prayer its weight.
shots.sfx: a low hum, lamp flicker

shots.vo: और कहते हैं, रानी शिवलिंग में समा गई।
shots.tts: [mysterious] और कहते हैं... रानी शिवलिंग में समा गई।
shots.prompt: inside a small old stone Shiva shrine with carved sandstone pillars and a dark polished stone Shivling on its base in the centre, brass oil lamps glowing, soft warm golden light gently fills the whole shrine from the Shivling, {AKOLA_RANI} kneeling, her figure fading softly into the glow, the Shivling stays whole and serene, {AKOLA_RAJA} at the doorway lowering his eyes
shots.motion: Locked camera. The golden glow slowly rises until the queen's figure fades into it. End with the empty glowing shrine and the Shivling whole and calm.
shots.goal: The legend's climax, shown with reverence.
shots.sfx: a rising soft choir-like hum, a single temple bell, then silence

shots.vo: आज भी लोग शिवलिंग की एक दरार को इसी कहानी से जोड़ते हैं।
shots.tts: आज भी लोग... शिवलिंग की एक दरार को इसी कहानी से जोड़ते हैं।
shots.prompt: extreme close-up of an old dark stone Shivling with one fine thin crack running down it, fresh marigold flowers and a small brass lamp beside it, morning light
shots.motion: Very slow push-in along the fine crack. End on the crack with the marigolds in soft focus.
shots.goal: Bring the legend to today: the crack people point to.
shots.sfx: morning birds, a soft bell far away

shots.vo: पर याद रखो, ये इतिहास नहीं, लोक-कथा है।
shots.tts: पर याद रखो... ये इतिहास नहीं, लोक-कथा है।
shots.prompt: top-down view of an old open palm-leaf folk-tale book on a wooden archive table, a small painted picture of a shrine on its page, a brass lamp at the edge
shots.motion: Slow top-down rotation over the open book. End with the painted shrine centred.
shots.goal: Make the honest legend flag clear.
shots.sfx: a page settling, archive room tone

shots.vo: सच या सिर्फ़ कहानी? कमेंट में लिखो।
shots.tts: [curious] सच... या सिर्फ़ कहानी? [excited] कमेंट में लिखो।
